results.answer: Our help articles disagree on the API rate limit for paid plans. One article states it is 1,000 requests per minute, while another article published on 1 September 2026 states that paid plans now get 2,000 requests per minute. We suggest confirming with support before relying on it. Note that limits are applied using a sliding window and are tracked per account rather than per API key, meaning all keys on an account share the same quota. Additionally, bulk export endpoints have a separate, lower limit of 10 requests per minute due to their higher processing cost. If you need a higher limit for a legitimate use case, you can contact support with your expected request volume.
